title: Some Remarks on Super $M_{p}$-groups
summary: Let $G$ be a finite group and $p$ be a prime divisor of $|G|$. An irreducible $p$-Brauer character $\varphi$ of $G$ is called super-monomial if every primitive $p$-Brauer character inducing $\varphi$ is linear. The group $G$ is said to be a super $M_{p}$-group if every irreducible $p$-Brauer character of $G$ is super-monomial. In this note, we investigate the conditions under which a finite group $G$ qualifies as a super $M_{p}$-group. We demonstrate that every normal subgroup of a super $M_{p}$-group of odd order is an $M_{p}$-group.
